readiness_policy: packet58-onecard-diet-engine: both diet views >=+0.5% over every warm max23 (record line) control, drift <=3%, 60/60 exact; chain rule >=+2% over every control view and >=37.335

definitions.transfer: transfer_wall_ms = head (token id + lookup rows) + tail (error/next_token) foreground transfer time
definitions.fill_bytes: same-position delta of cache.jsonl fill_bytes_total (submitted at that position start)
definitions.carrier_rule: head when head slope >= 0.6 x transfer slope, tail when <= 0.4 x, else both

A0.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

B0.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

A1.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

B1.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

A2.engine: compute queue: CCS kernel stores/loads to USM host memory; no copy command on any queue

fill_lever_price.rule: (filled minus unfilled wall outside the transfer window) x filled fraction; ceiling for any fill pacing/deferral, not a projection

mechanism_readout.collapse_rule: max B slow fraction <= 0.5 x min warm A slow fraction AND every B transfer slope <= 0.5 x every warm A slope
mechanism_readout.moved_rule: every B wall slope per same-token fill MB > 0.5 x every warm A wall slope
mechanism_readout.verdict: mixed: speed and transfer-slope collapse disagree; record and review before any follow-up

s58de_decision.saving_definition: (mean warm-control layer_body_ms - mean diet layer_body_ms) x 1000 / 48; layer_body_ms = wall_ms - transfer_wall_ms - prepare_ms of decode tokens (generated_index >= 2): the compute window between the head load and the tail check
s58de_decision.drm_guard: native after-load + supervisor refuse DRM total-vram0 > 30,500,000,000 B before any view (unchanged, never lowered)
s58de_decision.rule: screen winner iff both diet views >= 1.005 x every warm max23 control, 60/60 exact, drift <= 3 %, no kill; chain iff also >= 1.02 x every control view and >= 37.33456224; kills: inexact view, DRM > 30.5 GB, drift > 3 %, warm control < 36.0, saving < 5 us/layer, fills differ; no automatic rerun on any kill
